**Verdict: clean.** The review is a read of the diff. It made no local build. The release gate runs on the cut runner: cut.yml, stage gate, run 43848762891. It checks out release/v0.22.0, whose tip is this head 6445fe569.

**Check 1 - Diff scope: pass.** 63 files changed. They are: CHANGELOG.md (42 rows added), Cargo.toml (1 version line), Cargo.lock (10 version lines), RECOMMENDED.md (2485 lines added), RELEASE_NOTES.md (179 lines added), and 58 deletions in docs/decisions/. No code file is in the diff. Each commit stays in scope: a86eee810 changes only the docs files, c88a37872 only Cargo.toml, 6445fe569 only Cargo.lock.

**Check 2 - RELEASE_NOTES structure: pass.** The hunk is a pure insertion at the top of the file (@@ -1,3 +1,182; no deleted line). The Breaking section comes first. It leads with the project-format entry: version 61 to 62 (#1453, PR #2026). The new section ends with a --- separator. The v0.21.0 section follows it and is unchanged.

**Check 3 - No closing keyword: pass.** The scan covered the PR body, every added diff line, and the 3 commit messages. No GitHub closing keyword with an issue number is present. Issue citations use the (#N, PR #M) form.

**Check 4 - Start-condition record: pass, one note.** The body records: cut start 2026-11-16T10:18Z; main at f90e9dc8e (the merge of #2155); no open P1; open P2: #2004 only, released for this cut by the maintainer at 10:02Z. The notes repeat the start time and #2004 under Known issues. Both label states were checked against GitHub. The note, not a blocker: no line cites the green-main proof, post-merge run 43838057396 (completed/success at dab6498ae). The newer run 43847588352 for f90e9dc8e started at 10:18Z and was not green yet at the cut. The merge stop is in effect: main has not moved from f90e9dc8e.

**Check 5 - CHANGELOG rows, decisions, version: pass.** 42 rows were added, as the body says. Eight rows were compared with the Changelog line of their PRs (#2155, #2138, #2026, #1921, #1934, #2054, #2094, #2001). Each row text matches. The #2026 row adds the BREAKING mark and format 62; that is correct. RECOMMENDED.md gains one heading, v0.22.0 decisions gathered at the cut, appended after line 48183. It has no duplicate heading. The 58 gathered files equal the 58 deleted files. The version is 0.22.0 at all places: the Cargo.toml workspace line and 10 Cargo.lock entries. The only 0.21.0 string in code is a test fixture in xtask/src/release_tests.rs, not a version claim. The 61 merge commits in the window match the notes count: 5 feat, 48 fix, 1 refactor; the "7 tests, docs and process" equals 2 test, 3 docs, and 2 process PRs. PROCESS_VERSION 76 to 78 matches bump PRs #2117 and #2139.

**Check 6 - Commits: pass.** The branch cuts from main head f90e9dc8e; the merge-base with main is f90e9dc8e. The 3 new commits have conventional subjects: docs: 0.22.0 release notes; changelog / chore(release): 0.22.0 - release / chore(release): sync Cargo.lock to 0.22.0. History is not squashed: the merge commits of main are intact in the ancestors.

The PR is the cut. Merge it only after the gate run above is green, then start the tag stage.
